feeds.title: Broadway News
feeds.description: Broadway.com is one of the most comprehensive and widely used destinations for theatre information on the Internet. The site contains the most complete editorial coverage of theatre on the web, including the latest news, interviews with actors and playwrights, opening-night coverage, original theatre reviews and video features.

feeds.title: Broadway News
feeds.description: Get the latest and trendy broadway breaking news, headlines and reviews from your one and only accurate news source, Broadway News.

feeds.title: Broadway Black
feeds.description: Broadway Black is an organization that fosters and inspires artistic diversity and excellence in theatre. Dedicated to highlighting the achievements and successes of Black theatre artists on and off the Broadway stage. It's the place for Black people to see themselves center stage.

feeds.title: Broadway Artists Alliance Blog
feeds.description: Broadway Artists Alliance was founded with the goal of providing professional-level training to talented young musical theatre performers. Under the guidance of our incredible faculty, BAA students explore their creative talents, develop their performance techniques and build confidence in a challenging yet supportive environment.

feeds.title: Broadway in Chicago Blog
feeds.description: Broadway In Chicago was created in July 2000 and, over the past 18 years, has grown to be one of the largest commercial touring homes in the country. It presents a full range of entertainment on the stages of five theatres in the Chicago Theatre District.

feeds.title: Broadway & Me
feeds.description: I'm a theater lover. I am happiest when I am sitting in a theater. Or when I'm talking about theater. Or reading about theater. Or now blogging about it. If you're reading this, you're probably a theater lover too and I hope you'll keep me company as I blog my way through each Broadway season.

feeds.title: Masterworks Broadway » Blog
feeds.description: Masterworks Broadway is the home of new and classic cast albums, behind the scenes photos, exclusive videos and more.

feeds.title: Broadway Musical Blog
feeds.description: Dishing out musical theatre news and gossip from the Great White Way. The companion site to The Broadway Musical Home is a directory of Broadway musicals with the story, songs, merchandise, video clips, lyrics, tickets, rights & awards for almost 200 shows.

feeds.title: StageLight Magazine
feeds.description: StageLight Magazine brings you the best of Broadway, Off-Broadway and day to day of the NYC theatre world. StageLight Magazine is used as the program for several off-Broadway shows and also run StageLight Black and StageLight Paper.

feeds.title: Vintage Broadway
feeds.description: This forthcoming book, The Wizard of Oz on Broadway, has been a dream of David Maxine's for over two decades - blending his love of the Oz books, his passion for Musical Theatre, and the act of meticulous researching at one time he wanted to be an archaeologist.

feeds.title: Applause Theatre & Entertainment Service Blog
feeds.description: Read what's happening in and around Broadway in NYC and London. Stay tuned for special deals, promotions, and Broadway show reviews and news. Applause provides travel agents like you, with excellent service and superior seating for Broadway and the London Theatre, local concerts and sporting events, as well as nationwide events.

feeds.title: Ken Davenport Blog
feeds.description: Ken Davenport is a Tony Award-winning Broadway producer. His productions have been produced internationally in over 25 countries around the world. He is the founder of TheaterMakers Studio, a one-of-a-kind 'masterclass' community that provides training and inspiration from Broadway's best to writers, directors, producers, and more.

feeds.title: Broadway Licensing
feeds.description: Broadway Licensing and its family of imprints (Dramatists Play Service, Playscripts, and Stageworks) is the global leader in theatrical licensing and distribution. The iconic works represented epitomize the greatest collection of authors, composers, lyricists, and underlying rights holders across the globe including Arthur Miller, Tennessee Williams, Lynn Nottage, Alan Menken, Stephen King, Elvis, the Bee Gees, and the Beatles. Stay up to date with the latest news and updates on shown, artists, events scheduled and more!

feeds.title: BROADWAY NATION
feeds.description: A lively and opinionated cultural history of the Broadway Musical that tells the extraordinary story of how Immigrants, Jews, Queers, African-Americans and other outcasts invented the Broadway Musical, and how they changed America in the process.In Season One, host David Armstrong traces the evolution of American Musical Theater from its birth at the dawn of the 20th Century, through its mid-century 'Golden Age', and right up to its current 21st Century renaissance; and also explore how musicals have reflected and shaped our world -- especially in regard to race, gender, sexual orientation, ..

feeds.title: Stu on Broadway
feeds.description: Stuart Brown is the founder of the 24/7 online Broadway music radio station, Sounds of Broadway, which plays the best from the Off-Broadway, Broadway, and London stages. Thousands of songs from hundreds of cast albums are in rotation. He reviews NYC theater as a member of the Outer Critics Circle and reviews CT stage productions as a member of the CT Critics Circle.

feeds.title: The Gary on Broadway Blog
feeds.description: I'm Gary, a theater reviewer, which a flair for the un-dramatic. Join me on the journey to find latest in Broadway and Off-Broadway.

feeds.title: The Broadway Collective Blog
feeds.description: Learn about our courses, students stories, tips for broadway and more. Hi, I'm Robert! I'm a Broadway performer and Founder of The Broadway Collective. We're an elite academy, and we hold our students to the highest standards. If you are serious about working in the musical theatre industry, we can help you get that competitive edge and stand out.

feeds.title: The Broadway Edit Blog
feeds.description: My name is Leah, and I'm a public relations professional with a deep love for theatre and the performing arts, currently living in Los Angeles. I started The Broadway Edit in October 2020. As my site has grown, I've been able to collaborate with others in the theatre community, and have expanded from a show journal to a platform sharing stories not only of my own experiences but the stories of other theatre professionals and fans.

feeds.title: Broadway Play Blog
feeds.description: Broadway Play Home, the sister site to Broadway Musical Home, was created in 2019 as a celebration of the 20th anniversary of the original website. It is a resource for those seeking conveniently collected information on Broadway plays. On Broadway Play Blog they dish out theater news and gossip from the Great White Way!

feeds.title: My Theatre Weekend
feeds.description: Welcome to My Theatre Weekend! The website is all about helping you plan the perfect New York Theatre Weekend. Booking tips show recommendations, Theatre District restaurants, and hotels - we have it all.

feeds.title: Broadway Theater District Blog
feeds.description: The Broadway Theater District originated in the early 1900s as theaters began to move from Union Square further uptown to the Times Square area because of its cheaper real estate. The Broadway Theater District blog is a website dedicated to providing news and updates about the Broadway theater scene in New York City.

feeds.title: Broadway in Cincinnati News
feeds.description: Welcome to the news blog for Broadway in Cincinnati. Broadway in Cincinnati is committed to bringing the very best of Broadway to the Tri-State. We bring the finest national touring productions - blockbuster musicals, plays and family shows

feeds.title: Broadway DNA Blog
feeds.description: The Broadway DNA Blog is a weekly newsletter about theatrical IP from around the world, written by NYC-based producer Natalie Rine, founder of the international producing and licensing company Broadway DNA.

feeds.title: Broadway Crew Blog
feeds.description: Broadway Crew is a promotional marketing street team specializing in Broadway Promotions and Live Events, utilizing our super talented Brand Ambassadors to get amazing results for your activation, show, and brand.

feeds.title: 2 On the Aisle: Broadway at its Best
feeds.description: 2 On the Aisle: Broadway at its Best is the World of Broadway Musicals - the iconic, the eccentric, the downright peculiar. I play 'em all, here on WGMC Jazz 90.1. Here I'll add my weekly playlists.

feeds.title: Aladdin Musical
feeds.description: This blog is dedicated to Disney's Aladdin: Broadway's New Musical Comdey. Following a successful Pilot Production at Seattle's 5th Avenue Theatre in 2011, and regional and international productions in 2012, Disney announced that Aladdin would be coming to Broadway in 2014. Check out the latest announcement of the musical, trivial facts, behind-the-scenes and more!

feeds.title: Broadway.com Groups Blog
feeds.description: Group Sales Box Office, LLC is an affiliate of Broadway.com and appears on its website to make your group sales experience easier and more informed. It's our goal to help you plan an amazing Broadway experience for your group.

feeds.title: Broadway Play Publishing Inc Blog
feeds.description: Broadway Play Publishing Inc was established in New York City in 1982 with a mission to publish and license the stage performance rights of the finest contemporary American plays.

feeds.title: The Broadway Blog
feeds.description: The Broadway Blog is an insider's guide to theatre and live performance in New York City Broadway, Off-Broadway, and beyond. Get a personal spin on theatre news, the latest reviews, backstage gossip and exclusive interviews with the stars and creators of your favorite plays and musicals.

feeds.title: Broadway Direct
feeds.description: The Nederlander Organization established Broadway Direct in 2011 to help its patrons around the country stay connected to every show on Broadway. With this insider access, we're able to bring you the latest Broadway news, behind-the-scenes stories, backstage videos, and expert tips to help you find your next show.
